metadata.architecture: 9-Hop Python Orchestration with Feedback Loops + Complete Test Coverage + Immutable Staging Buffer + Hash Chain Audit Trail
metadata.description: v1.9.0 MAJOR RELEASE: Rearchitects entire workflow into 9 deterministic hops with Python orchestration. Each hop is a checkpoint with validation gates. LLM called only at HOP-3 with feedback loop (up to 5 attempts). Staging buffer immutable after creation. 464 total tests (194 v1.8.1 retained + 270 new). Maintains all v1.8.2 capabilities while adding hardened execution model.
metadata.breaking_changes: Execution model changed from 3-phase to 9-hop architecture. All validation gates now execute as discrete hop checkpoints. File I/O patterns unchanged - output files identical to v1.8.2.

patch_history.changes: Staging buffer scope isolation - validation gates read from staging_buffer only, artist_output deleted from scope
File generation hard enforcement - files sourced from staging_buffer only, added Section 0.7 Pipeline Visibility Table
QA report completeness enforcement - mandatory 13 sections (0-12), Section 13 completeness verification, recovery mechanisms
Headline character limit enforcement (≤90 chars total) via VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE gate

Complete enforcement-validation gap coverage: headline word count (≤4 per segment), bullet counts (K.5A=7, K.6A=6), competency count (6), skill count (8-12), summary structure (6 sentences, no bullets)
QA report Section 0.7 standardized to two-column key-value format for consistency and readability
Consolidated user patches: K.7 activation, K.10 split, company address RAG, K.9 restructure, 5 validation gates, 4 QA sections
Hardened skill generation to require exactly 12 skills and inverted authenticity ratio to 80% positioning.
Added a Keyword Normalization Engine to the skill generation process for better ATS alignment.

K0: Add explicit retrieval schema, authenticity fallback, peer JD sourcing, signal quality scoring. K2: Implement peer JD tier-matching, threshold calibration, synonym clustering, freshness validation. K.11: Build composite skill ranking (JD×K2×authenticity), dynamic normalization by industry, authenticity validation gate, competency-skill mapping enforcement. Add orchestration layer with cross-node consistency checks.

Hardens VG_VERSIONED_RESUME_FILENAME_COMPLIANCE to enforce strict pattern matching preventing date format violations like hyphens. Adds explicit regex validation, component-level validation for company/job ID/date format, comprehensive test cases for edge cases and format violations, and QA Report Section 7.2 for filename convention validation.

Hardens K.7 rendering with explicit bullet formatting specification (•), highlight count validation, truncation prevention, VG_K7_HIGHLIGHT_FORMATTING gate, temperature reduced to 0.2 for consistent output

Complete rearchitecture to 9-hop model with Python orchestration. Each hop is a deterministic checkpoint. LLM at HOP-3 only with feedback loop (max 5 attempts). Immutable staging buffer. Hash chain audit trail. 464 total tests (194 v1.8.1 + 270 new). All v1.8.2 validation gates retained.

validation_gates_at_hop_6.description: All v1.8.2 validation gates retained and executed at HOP-6

critical_rules: 9-HOP ARCHITECTURE: Workflow MUST execute all 9 hops in sequence
PYTHON ORCHESTRATION: All hops executed by Python. LLM called only at HOP-3.
DETERMINISTIC CHECKPOINTS: Each hop is a checkpoint. Workflow halts on any hop failure.
HOP-0: Source integrity validation (15 rules). Halt on failure.
HOP-1: Clerk extraction (18 rules). Flag hallucinations but continue.
HOP-2: Data enrichment (8 rules). Halt on failure.
HOP-3: Artist generation + validation + feedback loop (20 rules). Max 5 attempts. Halt after exhaustion.
HOP-4: Staging buffer creation + immutability lock (8 rules). CRITICAL: Delete artist_output from scope after creation.
HOP-5: Pre-flight validation + scope isolation verification (19 rules). MUST verify artist_output NOT in scope.
HOP-6: Batched QA with 130 rules. Generate all 13 sections. Flag failures but continue to HOP-7.
HOP-7: Gate decision. All hops pass → PROCEED. Any fail → ERROR_REPORT_ONLY.
HOP-8: File generation only if gate decision = PROCEED. Write 4 files. Verify hashes. Rollback on failure.
STAGING BUFFER: Created at HOP-4. Immutable (locked). Read-only access for HOP-5, HOP-6, HOP-7, HOP-8.
SCOPE ISOLATION: artist_output deleted at HOP-4. master_resume deleted at HOP-5. Validation gates cannot access.
FEEDBACK LOOP: HOP-3 only. Regenerates up to 5 times on validation failure. Saves checkpoints for each attempt.
HASH CHAIN: Optional. H0→H1→H2→...→H8. Verified at HOP-7. Warn on break but do not halt.
READ-BACK VERIFICATION: Mandatory at HOP-8. Every file read back and hash-verified. Rollback on mismatch.
COC LEDGER: Chain-of-Custody ledger generated with all hop checkpoints, timestamps, and hashes.
TEST COVERAGE: 464 tests total. 194 v1.8.1 regression + 270 new. 100% pass rate required.
BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY: All v1.8.2 validation gates retained. Output files identical to v1.8.2.
WORD COUNTS: All v1.8.2 word count rules retained (K.1: 118-135, K.4: ≤90 chars, ≤4 words/segment, etc.)
BULLET COUNTS: K.5A=7, K.6A=6 (v1.6.8)
COMPETENCY COUNT: K.8=6 (v1.6.8)
SKILL COUNT: K.11=12 (v1.7.6)
SENTENCE COUNT: K.1=6 sentences exactly (v1.6.8)
NO BULLET FORMATTING: K.1 MUST NOT contain bullet-like formatting (v1.6.8)
K.7 FORMATTING: All K.7 highlights MUST have • prefix (v1.8.2)
FILENAME PATTERN: Resume_{Company}_{JobAbbrev}_{YYYYMMDD}.txt (v1.8.1)
DATE FORMAT: YYYYMMDD with NO separators (no hyphens, slashes, dots)
FILE WRITES BLOCKED: On ANY validation gate failure at any hop
MANUAL TESTS: 4 critical manual tests required
